hypothesis.preparation: Foreground before frame waits; never writes live reader state or PSG.
hypothesis.publication: Atomic valid flag only if frame and all foreground reader parameters/requests unchanged.
hypothesis.fallback: Full-size existing IRQ reader on stale cache, late effect/music, speculative rejection or overflow.
hypothesis.limits: Prepared IRQ replay still waits physically; aim is to replace IRQ calculation with earlier idle-time preparation, not certify complete asynchronous output.

disposition: Reject all three foreground-preparation integrations. Reader state, source PSG states and musical byte/order remain exact across 14000 frames per region for all variants, but source video regresses. Avoiding a second wait after a preparation crossing reduces the regression, not eliminates it. Immediate-emission control also regresses NTSC and worsens spacing.
observations: Speculative state is separate; actual IRQ reader is the fallback for stale frames, changed requests, foreground fade/compensation parameters, rejection and compact-capacity overflow.

Variant01 baseline/candidate native intro line and timer remain equal at every sampled NTSC frame; intro callback clock differs on12209 and actor counter on3369. The clock/source mismatch is much larger than baseline. Foreground callback phase is therefore a separate integration issue, not a musical-state mismatch.
Variant03 removes dated wait but retains speculative computation/cache use. It does not prove preparation alone causes all drift because emission work also changes relative to production.
next_action: Trace full-IRQ requests/acknowledgement and F09/F32 callback publication against the source IRQ phase; integrate source callback scheduling independently of native reader cost. For asynchronous PSG delivery retain real preparation/publication deadlines and first-write phase. Do not tune animation counters to a recorded frame or assume matching end-of-frame PSG states imply correct video/audio timing.
limits: No interactive input, boss, SRAM or full-game test of these rejected prototypes.
The source C02F clock probe is NTSC only; PAL video/audio reports are separate.
No PCM equality, absolute source audio phase, hardware or complete asynchronous scheduler claim.
Production sources and V319 ROM unchanged by this experiment.
